definition: to find out if you may do something
description: Seen through a doorway, a sunny whitewashed courtyard with a red tiled roof and a cobbled floor. A young woman in a burgundy riding shirt, beige breeches and tall black boots holds the bridle of a dappled grey horse and smiles. A young man in a light blue shirt and cream trousers stands in front of the horse, reaches one hand towards its head while looking at her, then gently strokes its face, smiling. A leather saddle rests on a stand behind them, with red geraniums in pots, a wall lantern and loose straw.
